editorial:
Imagine taking a relaxing trip to a quiet southern town only to find out that almost everyone has vanished. That is exactly what happens to Josh and Mike. The vibe is creepy and lonely from the start, making you feel like something is watching from the trees. When Mike goes missing, the story turns into a race against time. You get to follow Josh as he teams up with a local teacher and the sheriff to figure out why the town is so empty. It feels like those classic eighties movies where a simple vacation turns into a total nightmare.

What really works here are the surprises and the slow build of tension. While some of the acting is a bit stiff, the mystery keeps you guessing until the end. The pacing is steady, though it takes a minute to get going. If you love old-school creature features, you should definitely check this out. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best quality, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a great pick for a rainy weekend with friends.
endingExplained: You find out that the town is being hunted by a scary monster from another dimension. In the final scenes, Josh discovers that the creatures are using the townspeople for their own dark reasons. After a big fight, Josh manages to save his brother and stop the monsters from taking over. Everything wraps up with the survivors escaping the town, though the ending leaves you wondering if all the creatures were actually defeated for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves retro horror and weird sci-fi mysteries.
